pwa.title: Asnas n tiliɣri
pwa.description_owner: Sbedd Saloneo deg tiliɣri-k, ad k-d-yaweḍ yiwen n ulɣu i yal asekles, asefsex, asuter n usteɛfu neɣ taladna ɣer umsaḍuf.
pwa.description_staff: Sbedd Saloneo deg tiliɣri-m, ad m-d-yaweḍ ulɣu ɣef yimesfasen-im imaynuten d tririt ɣef usteɛfu-m.
pwa.description_supplier: Sbedd Saloneo deg tiliɣri-k, ad k-d-yaweḍ ulɣu ɣef yal taladna yettwaxelṣen d yal izen n usalun.
pwa.install_how: I wakken ad t-tesbeddeḍ deg tiliɣri-a:
pwa.ios_step2: Sit ɣef tqeffalt Bḍu, ddaw n ugdil.
pwa.ios_step3: Fren « Rnu ɣer ugdil agejdan », syin « Rnu ».
pwa.android_step1: Ldi Saloneo deg Chrome, sit ɣef wumuɣ ⋮ s afella ɣer yefus.
pwa.android_step2: Fren « Sbedd asnas » neɣ « Rnu ɣer ugdil agejdan ».
pwa.blocked: Ilɣa n Saloneo ttwaḥebsen. Sireg-iten deg yiɣewwaṛen n yiminig neɣ n tiliɣri, syin uɣal-d ɣer da.
pwa.ios_install_first: Deg iPhone, rnu qbel Saloneo ɣer ugdil agejdan (iOS 16.4 neɣ ugar), syin ldi asnas akken ad tesremdeḍ ilɣa.
pwa.unsupported: Iminig-a ur yessefrak ara ilɣa. Seqdec Chrome, Edge, Firefox neɣ Safari imaynuten.
pwa.error: Ur yezmir ara ad yermed yilɣa. Senqed tuqqna, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
